objectives: Geoengineering（地球工程）是一種使用大型技術手段來故意改變地球氣候系統的做法，目的是減緩或逆轉氣候變遷，尤其是針對全球暖化的影響。地球工程為一新興科學，原來為解決全球變遷等大尺度問題而提出。基本上可以土木及環境工程兩大方面。本課程將從地質背景出發，結合工程問題及其處理對策，提供學生一個整合性的思考及基礎的地質知能。
content:
Week 1-  Introduction & Overview of Geoengineering
Week 2 -  Solar system
Week 3 -  The Solid Earth
Week 4 -  Tectonics
Week 5 -  Mineral and Mineralogy
Week 6 -  Rock forming mineral
Week 7 -  Igneous rock
Week 8 -  Sedimentary rock
Week 9 -  Metamorphic rock
Week 10 - Geological structures: Brittle deformation
Week 11 - Geological structures: Ductile deformation
Week 12 – Ocean
Week 13 - Weathers and Climates
Week 14 - Solar Radiation Management
Week 15 – Carbon Dioxide Removal Techniques
Week 16 – Global changes and social impacts
books:
1.	Earth: An Introduction to Physical Geology: Edward J. Tarbuck, Frederick K. Lutgens, Dennis G. Tasa, Pearson
2.	Geoengineering: The Gamble: Gernot Wagner, Polity Press
3.	Engineering the Climate: The Ethics of Solar Radiation Management: Christopher J. Preston, Lexington
4.	Geotechnical Engineering and Climate Change: Ricardo J. Maia (ed.), CRC Press
5.	Introduction to Environmental Engineering and Science: Gilbert M. Masters, Wendell P. Ela, Pearson
